intents_zh: 用 pg 做事件通知
code:
import psycopg2, select
conn = psycopg2.connect('{{dsn}}')
conn.set_isolation_level(psycopg2.extensions.ISOLATION_LEVEL_AUTOCOMMIT)
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute("LISTEN {{channel_name}};")
print('listening on {{channel_name}}')
while True:
    if select.select([conn], [], [], 5) == ([], [], []):
        continue
    conn.poll()
    while conn.notifies:
        n = conn.notifies.pop(0)
        print('got NOTIFY:', n.pid, n.channel, n.payload)
summary_zh: 用 LISTEN/NOTIFY 做 postgres 即時事件訂閱
